headline: Trap Hole
title: Trap Hole Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Trap Hole. What is it? It is a Normal Trap Card, and one of the oldest traps in the game. What does it do? When your opponent Normal Summons or Flip Summons a monster with one thousand or more attack, destroy that monster. How do you use it? Set it and wait for a strong Normal Summon. It does not work on Special Summons, so it is best against decks that Normal Summon their key monsters. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
